projects.title: Paper Podcasts
projects.plainEnglish: [draft] It reads new research papers and turns them into a short podcast.
projects.techLine: [draft] Python pipeline: arXiv, LLM summaries, text to speech, FastAPI and React.

caseStudy.problem: [draft] Keeping up with AI research is a reading problem: most papers never get read. Audio turns dead time into reading time.
caseStudy.built: [draft] A four-stage pipeline (download, extract, summarise, generate audio) that can resume from any stage; a library UI with listen state; two storage backends (local, Azure) behind one interface.

decisions.title: [draft] A state machine, not a script
decisions.text: [draft] A failed stage is retried instead of restarting the whole run.

decisions.title: [draft] Write locally, then persist
decisions.text: [draft] The container disk is ephemeral, so artifacts are saved to storage after each stage.

decisions.title: [draft] Pause polling when idle
decisions.text: [draft] The frontend stops polling so the apps can scale to zero.

caseStudy.architecture: [draft] Four services run in order (arXiv download, PDF to text with markitdown, LLM summary, text to speech) behind a status state machine that saves state after each stage and resumes from it. LLM and TTS sit behind provider interfaces. FastAPI backend and React frontend on Azure Container Apps.

projects.title: TfL agent
projects.plainEnglish: [draft] Ask how the Tube is doing, and a second deployed agent answers.
projects.techLine: [draft] MCP tools on Azure Functions and an A2A agent over live TfL data.

caseStudy.problem: [draft] A real, public API with real disruptions is a good test bed for tool design: batching, failure handling, and knowing which line ids are valid.
caseStudy.built: [draft] Five tools (line status, disrupted lines, station search, journey planning, arrivals), the Function App that serves them, and an A2A agent other agents can call.

decisions.title: [draft] Batch by mode, not per line
decisions.text: [draft] Fewer calls and one failure mode.

decisions.title: [draft] The agent reads tool schemas at startup
decisions.text: [draft] No duplicated schemas to keep in step.

decisions.title: [draft] A2A instead of a shared library
decisions.text: [draft] A second deployed agent can call this one without sharing code.

caseStudy.architecture: [draft] Five MCP tools in an Azure Function App, also runnable over stdio. A LangGraph agent served over A2A.

projects.title: CopilotKit agent canvas
projects.plainEnglish: [draft] A chat where the assistant builds charts and documents on a canvas while you talk, and can hand questions to other agents.
projects.techLine: [draft] Next.js 16, CopilotKit v2 and AG-UI, a LangGraph agent with frontend tools, A2A delegation, Playwright suites, Azure Container Apps.

caseStudy.problem: [draft] The interesting part of agent UX is not the chat bubble but the agent changing the thing you are looking at.
caseStudy.built: [draft] Frontend tools for charts and markdown documents with an inventory the agent reads back; delegation to other agents with progress streamed into a trace panel; a two-tier browser test suite.

decisions.title: [draft] Tool calls instead of shared graph state
decisions.text: [draft] A simpler contract and easier tests.

decisions.title: [draft] Compile chart specs before rendering
decisions.text: [draft] The agent gets the error and can retry.

decisions.title: [draft] Two test tiers
decisions.text: [draft] A fake agent for fast tests and a scripted model for real protocol coverage.

caseStudy.architecture: [draft] Next.js 16 and CopilotKit v2 frontend talking AG-UI to a LangGraph agent on FastAPI. The agent delegates to a second LangGraph agent over A2A as a plain backend tool.

projects.title: Restaurant Researcher
projects.plainEnglish: [draft] A personal venue finder with an agent that learns what he likes.
projects.techLine: [draft] Next.js, CopilotKit and a LangGraph agent over Google Places.

caseStudy.problem: [draft] Every recommendation app knows what everyone likes. This one should know what he likes, down to the dish.
caseStudy.built: [draft] A card board with fast search and background research per venue, and a taste profile the agent reasons from.

decisions.title: [draft] First paint never waits for the model
decisions.text: [draft] Research arrives later and fills in the cards.

decisions.title: [draft] Cache venue data within the provider's terms

caseStudy.architecture: [draft] Next.js 16 (React 19, Tailwind 4) frontend with a FastAPI backend. Chat and places are still stubs and fixtures in the repo, so the owner rewrites this line when the real agent lands.
